results.question: ยอดขายต่อพนักงานของแต่ละสำนักงาน
results.gold_sql: SELECT o.city AS office, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber) AS employees, ROUND(SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber), 2) AS sales_per_employee FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber LEFT JOIN orders ord ON c.customerNumber = ord.customerNumber LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON ord.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY o.officeCode LIMIT 500
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
  o.officeCode,
  o.city,
  COALESCE(SUM(sd.sale_amount), 0) AS total_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber) AS employee_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE COALESCE(SUM(sd.sale_amount), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber)
  END AS sales_per_employee
FROM employees AS e
JOIN offices AS o
  ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    od.orderNumber,
    od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach AS sale_amount,
    c.salesRepEmployeeNumber
  FROM orderdetails AS od
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber
  JOIN customers AS c
    ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber
) AS sd
  ON e.employeeNumber = sd.salesRepEmployeeNumber
GROUP BY
  o.officeCode,
  o.city
ORDER BY
  sales_per_employee DESC
LIMIT 500
